To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
tropomyosin enhances the activation of Limulus myofibrillar ATPase by actin and that tropomyosins of various species activate Limulus ATPase.
tropomyosin is required to fully activate the Limulus ATPase.

Limulus myofibrils and myosin are fully activated by tropomyosins of different animals, and that Limulus myofilaments and myosin, at low ionic strengths, have a higher affinity for modified actin (actin-tropomyosin) than for pure actins.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of tropomyosin in the activation of myosin by actin.
the mechanism of activation of actomyosin by tropomyosins of different animal origins.
the activation by tropomyosins of the ATPase activity of myosin.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Limulus tropomyosin activates the ATPase of actomyosin by increasing the affinity of myosin for actin.
the ATPase of actomyosin is stimulated by the tropomyosins of several different species and that tropomyosin may be an activator of the ATPase of some myosins.
tropomyosin activates the Limulus ATPase in the presence of pure actin and that tropomyosine is not required for actin activation of scallop and of rabbit myosin.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the activation of Limulus ATPase by actin requires tropomyosin but that the activation of the ATPases of other animals by pure actin does not require tropomyosin.
tropomyosin is a necessary activator of the Limulus actomyosin ATPase and that the tropomyosins of different species are interchangeable in this respect.
tropomyosin increases the affinity of actin for myosin, and thus increases the rate at which actin and myosin can interact to hydrolyze ATP.
The main takeaway from our work is that
tropomyosin is required for full actin stimulation of the Limulus myosine ATPase.
tropomyosin is required to make Limulus myosins actin-activated ATPase activity approach the level of natural actomyosis.
the presence of tropomyosin is necessary for full activation of Limulus myofibril and natural actomyosins.
